title: Pocketwire Rewards Terms on Points Expiry and Forfeiture at Closure
content:
Pocketwire Rewards points expire after a period of inactivity on tiers with an expiry period, and are forfeited when the membership closes. The tier figure named here is the tier's inactivity expiry in calendar months.

## Terms

1. On tiers whose inactivity expiry is not 0, the whole positive points balance expires once no earning or redemption has occurred for that many calendar months since the last activity. The last activity is the latest date among the membership's earning entries, boost entries and redemption entries, or the enrolment date when there are none.
2. The expiry is dated the same day of the month that many months after the last activity, falling back to the month's last day when that day does not exist.
3. Closing the membership forfeits the whole positive balance on the closure date. Leaving the program is the member's own decision, confirmed by the member, and a member who wants value from the points redeems them before closing.
4. Expired or forfeited points are never restored, including on re-enrolment, and a negative balance is simply cleared on closure without any charge.

## Expiry dates (hypothetical last activity dates)

| Last activity | Expiry period | Expiry date |
|---|---|---|
| 31 August 2024 | 12 months | 31 August 2025 |
| 31 August 2024 | 18 months | 28 February 2026, February 2026 having no 31st |
| 15 March 2024 | 24 months | 15 March 2026 |
| any date | 0 | points never expire |

## Points of judgement

- Only earning, boost and redemption entries set the last activity; a bonus, referral or courtesy credit entry does not move it.
- A member who closes with a balance of 4000 points forfeits all 4000 on the closure date; a member who closes with a balance below zero owes nothing, the negative balance being cleared.
